# Lupolen3621 M RM
Containers; Tanks, Industrial Market Consumer Products; Industrial Packaging; Industrial, Building & Construction Processing Method Rotomolding Attribute Good Processability; High ESCR (Environmental Stress Cracking Resistance); Low
Vicat Softening Temperature, (A/50 N) 113 °C ISO 306 Processing Parameters
### Thermal
Physical
Temperature Impact Resistance; Low Warpage
Tensile Impact Strength 104 kJ/m² ISO 8256
Note: Cond. B, 10% Arkopal N100
Melt Flow Rate, (190 °C/2.16 kg) 7.5 g/10 min ISO 1133-1 Density 0.9355 g/cm³ ISO 1183-1
Regulatory Status For regulatory compliance information, see Lupolen3621 M RM Product Stewardship Bulletin (PSB) and Safety Data Sheet (SDS). This grade is supported for use in drinking water applications.
Tensile Modulus 700 MPa ISO 527-1, -2 Tensile Stress at Yield 17 MPa ISO 527-1, -2 Tensile Strain at Break > 450 % ISO 527-1, -2 Tensile Strain at Yield 10 % ISO 527-1, -2 Environmental Stress Crack Resistance, F   > 1000 hr ASTM D1693
Page 1 of 3
Product Description Lupolen3621 M RM is a new generation hexene linear low density polyethylene for rotational molding. Typical customer applications include agricultural and chemical storage containers and technical parts. This product exhibits excellent ESCR and high impact strength at low temperatures. Lupolen3621 M RM is a UV-stabilized and pelletized polymer. Tests have shown that this material is resisting against the harmful effect of biodiesel fuel*. It is not intended for use in medical and pharmaceutical applications.
